generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a tall, straight pine with a narrow crown of slender, level branches and soft needles in fives. Not fitted to measurements. Cones (plant forms F3): 10 to 25 cm, long and slender, hanging from the top; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured. Spray area (plant roadmap P4): the area its card draws now that its needles stand in fascicles.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 28 m tall and 45 cm across at breast height at 60 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: blue-green needles; grey bark broken into small square plates. Needle shoots (plant roadmap P4): slender needles in fives, 5 to 13 cm long and under 1 mm wide, so a needle 0.012 as wide as it is long (`width`), 5 to a fascicle (`bundle`), from general knowledge of the species, not measured.
